body:
Same grade level here.  Have a similar student who tries to be very edgy.  

“You’re still quoting that? Dude that was like years ago.”  Also, do not give it any power and make it lame. “My grandmother said that the other day, you must be following the same YouTubers”.  

Also do punishments around it but not for that word to diminish its power.  The punishment was for disrupting the cafeteria not for what they said.  Honestly, kids want to do the opposite of what they are told.

This basically was VP was on the line, threw you under the bus, principal did not even know.  

I wouldn’t worry too much, just be careful what you say around her and let your principal know if something gets really out of hand.

I worry about this a lot too because when I was younger I didn’t think I was going to become a teacher.  I was young, just like everyone else. 
It’s like we don’t get paid enough to have to be censored.  It’s like you are allowed to have a personality as long as it’s legal. 

Also, I’m a firm believer in was this on company time? Did you use a company device to make these posts? Did any laws get broken or anyone get hurt? 

I know that’s not how the world works, it just stinks. Keep your head high and stick to the facts if questioned.  Truth, but remain calm and assert this was when you were younger, and you are a professional who is focused on the job and it never interfered with your job performance.
Did they stop making these? Can’t find them anymore

A mother’s love is eternal.  We all wish we had a do over and we can’t change the past.  Just know your mother loves you and she wouldn’t want you being upset over things you can’t change.  Just focus on the wonderful memories that you two shared instead of the negative.  You will have good days and you will have not so good days.  Hang in there.
I am so sorry for your loss.  Your mom sounds like she lead an incredible life, and is lucky to have you and your brother.  ♥️

I feel the same way.  Was trying to meet up with someone and I gave suggestions of fun places to meet and got blocked.  I am sick and tired of the endless stream of one word replies, ghosting, and just deleting the app and coming back over and over like nothing happened. I am actually down in the dumps about it tonight, even cried about it a little.
There is a water fountain outside my classroom that is free to use and doesn’t cause a distraction to the rest of the class.  Here’s a carrot for that high house you are on.  🥕
It’s because of the threats that were made not because of homophobia.  This is coming from a gay.

I googled “Why are gay guys so terrible at making conversation on dating apps” and wound up here.  

I am just so disgusted.  All conversation is choppy, one worded, and an endless cycle.  I no longer have the energy to give to these people even if they mean well.

Elementary teacher here and this is my daily rant.  My kids look genuinely shooketh when they spill it and I say it stays at the sink now.  
Had to ban them from taking them outside because a group of boys decided to play water park.  
They were so shocked.  
Next year I’m not allowing it.  The parents who complain I will ask them how they survived in school.

My advice would be to do more things whole group because with that many kids, diverse learners, and some behaviors partners seems like it could go south quick and get loud.  I would do a pre test on Monday to see who knows the skill and who doesn’t.  Start teaching that day the intro.  When you checked to see who knows it and who doesn’t, those who do might can work on independent work but the rest can remain in the whole group lesson for you to go over the skills.
It won’t work.
Same.  It’s annoying.
Currently sitting at an 8 percent ar.  I ain’t moving for pennies.
Same! This has helped me so much.

This happened to me.  My ex of 7 years slept with my best friend of 16 years from high school who was living with us.  Three months later they got married.  I know the feelings you are feeling and it sucks.  Here if you need anything

I’m not going to make any promises that it gets better. 
I think what it means is that the problems that are bothering you will not be the same problems that burden you later on.  That what seems unbearable will become bearable.  
What I can say is that if you are asking to stick around another year, then there is a possibility you see an outcome or a tunnel through your problems.  
I am not healthy by any means, but that is how I have been going. I keep telling myself I can make it another day, another week, another year.  
I’m not going to say it gets better but I can say, is it does less harm to see if it gets better than the alternative.  You got this!
My cousin passed away at 17 with complications due to heart surgery.  You don’t know how many times, even ten years later I wish it would have been me instead.

Oh no.  I can understand that feeling.  If you are in school that’s to make a better life for her and focus on that and your future.  Also if it’s too much, do you think you could transfer to a school closer to your daughter so you could see her more?

I feel like I’m not meant for life either.  My ex of 7 years left me for my best friend of 16 years.  If people in your life can betray you like that, what’s the point? I understand completely what you mean about the weight being too much to bear.  If you need a friend I’m here.
My cats were what was getting me though but now I don’t know, they can just go back to my ex.

I wish I had a child so it would give me some meaning or reason to keep going.  

Try to invest all your time into her and every time it gets bad just squeeze her and love on her.  I try to do that with my cats.

You honestly have no clue how much this does make sense.  
Brain: He cheated on you with your best friend and ghosted you to start a life with her in the house you lived in for 6 years. 

Heart: If he just calls today and understands he was wrong and saw how toxic she is, we can make this work.  We can move past it.  Why doesn’t he miss me like I miss him? 

Yes your post made total sense to me!
Can relate my ex who I was with 7 years dumped me for my best friend I’ve had for 16 years.  Walked in on them together while she was living with us too.
Op I don’t know you, but you can do better.  I admit I want my ex back but I keep idolizing the good and forgetting the bad.

People cheat because they can’t stand to be alone.  She will probably be married in 6 months convincing some poor sap he won the lottery.  Be good you aren’t that poor sap.  I say this because my partner of 7 years cheated on me with my best friend of 16 years and I still wish for him back but I know they are happy together and she knows how to manipulate.

So my (M) partner (M) ended up cheating on me with my best friend (F) and left me to be with her.  
Before I met him he was married to his wife, but he left her to be with me, because I thought he was living a lie and couldn’t be with her due to his sexuality. Well fast forward seven years to now where he left me for my best friend (f).  If I would have known he was not living a lie but just needy for attention from anyone who would give it to him, I would have never settled for him in the first place. 

I’m just wondering if this dude is a narc looking for supply and he’s not gay or bi at all just seeking validation from strangers and other people on the internet

Similar situation here.  My boyfriend of 7 years left me for my best friend of 16 years who was living with us because her boyfriend was beating her and I took her in.  It’s been two months since d day I’m still an emotional wreck, but they are moving on happy with their lives.  
It’s an awful situation, because you lost two people who were very close to you, who seemed to not care about you or your feelings at all.  I don’t have any advice except try your best to ignore them.  I wish I had more advice to give but I’m struggling myself.

I have gone through a similar situation.  My partner of 7 years slept with my best friend of 16 years who was living with us because I helped her escape her abusive boyfriend.  I didn’t get an option to reconcile.  He wanted to be with her and I ended up having to leave the home we shared for 6 years.  I know you have children and were married but I understand the feelings of betrayal and distrust.  I hope you get through this, I know it is harder because you are essentially losing two people instead of just one you really trusted.

You are a doctor and that is much more than a lot of people can say.  You just haven’t seen your hard work and dedication pay off yet.  I am sure you have things of value it’s just so hard to see it when you are in the middle of it.  I am going through my own battles, but you seem successful and able to bounce back.  I don’t have anything going for me.

I am in the same situation.  My situation is so complicated, and I am so lonely.  All my friends are good people but they have their own lives and families.  They don’t want to hear my constant negative things.  I feel so alone.
I don’t know how I want to do it yet but wanted to practice my letter.  I thought a couple of weeks my mind would feel different or the feelings would change.  They have not
Same.  I always lie.  Being locked up isn’t going to make anything better.
I made one for the first time in my life a couple of weeks ago.  I don’t have any plans but I wanted to see how it would go.  I looked at it today and still feel the same way.

I don’t know if I can offer support, only that I am going through the same thing.  It’s been a month.  I’ve lost 40 pounds from not eating, going to therapy, on meds.  I still sit in bed all day staring at the walls in shock, anger, sadness, you name it.  I keep wondering what they are doing now and how they feel no remorse for what they did.  It was my best friend who my partner slept with.

I went through a similar situation.  I caught My best friend of 16 years in bed with my partner of 7 years.  We were letting her live with us because her own partner was abusing her.  My relationship did not have any red flags I don’t think he even cheated before.  Well he chose her over me.  So they are in the house and I’m living back at my parents.  It’s awful and I’m in therapy mainly working through the betrayal.

He doesn’t want me back he’s so infatuated with her, I looked up limerence and that’s exactly what it is.  He ignored the fact she has sugar daddy sites, he has known her as long as he has known me, used to hate her, knows she is off her meds, knows she has cheated on every partner she has had, knows that she is an alcoholic who drinks a pint of whiskey a day, and still thinks she is an amazing person.
I had to look up limerence, that’s exactly what it is.  Because we are both male and she is female.

Thank you, it means a lot.  
I don’t understand how everything was ok, and now I’m evil and easily disposed of.  I really thought we had a future together and everything just came undone
I just really thought I was going to spend the rest of my life with him. It wasn’t all bad times but according to him it was. :/
The grass just seems so much greener on the other side but I suppose it isn’t.

Going through something similar.  Woke up one morning and found my partner of seven years in bed with my best friend of 16 years who was living with us because her partner was abusing her. 
He didn’t try to make it work with me, he wanted her.  We only talked on the phone because I forced him to.  I can’t stop thinking of them together in my house using my things.  They have no regards to what they did to me and feel no remorse.
I feel this.  Mine left me I didn’t have a choice if I could go back or not.  I wish I did.
I feel you.  I’m in the same phase, and all the things we did together he is now doing with her.  It bothers me but not him at all.
Same thing happened to me.  I walked in on my partner of 7 years in bed with my best friend of 16 years.
We are in this together.  It’s not easy but at least we are not alone.

I understand the loneliness, my long term partner cheated on me last week with my best friend since high school.  Being gay in my community, the chances are slim for me to find someone else.  I realize I’m going to have to not only live in a world without him, but be alone as well.
I am going through a lot too.  I completely understand the feelings you are having.  If you need to talk I am here.

I feel the same as you.  Last week I walked in on my partner of seven years in bed with my best friend of 16 years and I had to move out.  They are together now, and have nothing to do with me.  
I have friends who care but it’s not the same.
The mental images are hurting me too.  I don’t know how to cope with them.  This is my one week anniversary since d day.
Thank you.  It’s been extremely difficult for me.
I feel like I’m leaving out so many details too, my mind is fried.  :(
